title: python/src/lichen/channel_plan.py: Standalone select_channel has same out-of-bounds bug (lines 189-200)
description:
The standalone select_channel function (lines 189-200) has identical logic to the method and the same bug: for plans with num_channels <= 2, it returns indices outside the valid range [0, num_channels-1].

Fix suggestion: Apply the same fix as to the method version, or have this function delegate to plan.select_channel() to avoid code duplication.
close_reason: Duplicate of project-LICHEN-worker6-61ja, fixed in same commit.
